text:
Gold Price in 2026
Among 9 monthly observations available for 2026, the LBMA gold price fell 14.5% between 2026-01-30 ($4,982) and 2026-09-25 ($4,261). The highest sampled price was $5,222 in February and the lowest was $4,026 in June. The mean of these observations was $4,538. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
